android.desc:
SunriseClock is a 24 hour analog clock widget with a face that represents daytime/night.  Sunrise and sunset times are displayed as well as the current moon phase. 

Features
- 24 hour analog clock widget with multiple face and layout options
- Customizable color themes
- Displays sunrise, sunset as well as astromomical, nautical and civil times
- Moonrise and moonset times
- Moon phases
- App displays position of the sun and moon
- Sun and Moon positions


Helpful feedback welcome.  If you have questions/suggestions, send me an email.

IMPORTANT:
You must configure your location after you add the widget to your home screen.  To do this, tap the clock and go to settings.  You may resize the widget by long-pressing.

If the clock "freezes", try disabling battery-saver or battery optimization.
